invariants.observableBehavior: Unknown settings, empty or wildcard user allowlists, unknown tools, and unsafe relative configuration are rejected; configured paths resolve against the configuration directory.
invariants.permittedDifference: jeo owns .jeo paths and JEO-prefixed defaults; these branding differences do not weaken validation.

focusedProof.assertion: requires exact explicit allowlists and rejects unknown or unsafe configuration

invariants.observableBehavior: A configured platform requires a nonempty, trimmed credential and reports only the environment-variable name rather than the credential value.
invariants.permittedDifference: jeo accepts both JEO and legacy JEOPI default names during migration while keeping the same fail-closed and non-disclosure behavior.

focusedProof.assertion: supports JEO and JEOPI default credential aliases without exposing values

invariants.observableBehavior: Only explicitly allowed users and channels dispatch; guild top-level messages require a bot mention, while direct messages and authorized Discord thread follow-ups do not.
invariants.permittedDifference: Authenticated allowlisted participants in an allowed Discord thread share its persistent session; session identity is not thread-owner authorization.

focusedProof.assertion: authorizes only the configured user, channel and mention shape

invariants.observableBehavior: Bot, webhook, self, malformed, empty, and unsupported events are ignored; bot mentions are stripped and attachment fields remain untrusted message data.
invariants.permittedDifference: The jeo boundary is named normalizeDiscordMessage; its externally visible filtering and normalized fields are equivalent.

focusedProof.assertion: only an allowlisted human in the configured channel can dispatch; malformed events are inert

invariants.observableBehavior: Conversation identity includes platform, account, guild, effective parent channel, and thread or conversation. Discord thread participants share persistent history across message IDs; direct messages and non-thread conversations preserve sender isolation.
invariants.permittedDifference: The approved session-container contract replaces independent-message and Discord-thread-sender sessions with one persistent session per thread. Tagged optional components prevent absent and literal identifiers from colliding; human authorization remains independent from session identity.

focusedProof.assertion: session routing preserves shared thread continuity and isolates distinct threads

invariants.observableBehavior: A message ID executes at most once, requests in one conversation stay ordered, and observable processing then success or failure status surrounds the outbound reply.
invariants.permittedDifference: Status wording may use the jeo product name; ordering, deduplication, and success/failure observability must remain equivalent.

focusedProof.assertion: deduplicates, serializes a conversation, sends status and reply

invariants.observableBehavior: A top-level guild request receives its own reply thread, follow-ups remain in that conversation, and direct messages receive direct replies.
invariants.permittedDifference: None at the observable routing boundary.

focusedProof.assertion: routes DMs by sender and server work by thread, deterministically

invariants.observableBehavior: Gateway discovery accepts only a parsed canonical wss Discord hostname without user-info, a non-default port, fragment, or alternate path before connecting.
invariants.permittedDifference: jeo may expose additional bounded reconnect diagnostics, but cannot relax origin validation.

focusedProof.assertion: canonical Discord Gateway origin validation matches the pinned contract

invariants.observableBehavior: Incoming Discord files are materialized privately only after bounded transport and declared-size checks, with failures rejecting the inbound attachment operation.
invariants.permittedDifference: The Seed requires MAX_ARTIFACTS=10 and stricter HTTPS trusted-CDN validation at every redirect hop; jeo intentionally strengthens the pinned reference.

focusedProof.assertion: trusted redirects are followed manually and every redirect destination is validated

invariants.observableBehavior: Output markers retain only bounded regular files beneath the per-conversation artifact directory, while traversal and symbolic links fail closed.
invariants.permittedDifference: jeo may stage daemon output in a request-scoped directory; byte identity and confinement remain observable requirements.

focusedProof.assertion: uploads at most ten regular in-root files and blocks traversal and symlinks

invariants.observableBehavior: Setup verifies bot and application identity, Message Content intent, explicit owners and channels, required permissions, private credential storage, a runnable script, and Gateway reachability before completion.
invariants.permittedDifference: Generated command and token names are branded for jeo; setup safety and completion gates remain equivalent.

focusedProof.assertion: Discord setup recognizes accepted team members and rejects non-bot tokens
